王野坐下后，也直接了当的说道：“舅舅，出差这些天我也想过很多，也有些想法。”

秦伟：“有想法好呀，说说。”

王野清了清嗓子说道：“我的初衷是不会变的，我以后肯定不会从军从政。”

秦伟皱着眉头问道：“那你想干什么？”

王野看出了秦伟的不高兴，平心静气的说：“舅舅，从军也好，从政也罢，我相信有你的从中协助，我就算不是青云直上，也不会默默无闻。但是这里边有个致命的问题，就是我的性格。”

秦伟好奇的问道：“我觉的你的性格很适合这些呀，你说说你的性格有什么致命问题？”

王野说道：“不论从军还是从政，有一条必须点，那就是无私奉献。我不说是一个自私的人，但也没有那么伟大。真要是在工作中出现了公私冲突的问题，我真不知道怎样处理。”

秦伟没有说话，只是紧紧的盯着王野，想在他的表情中听出是不是敷衍自己，但是在王野对自己评价时，他并没有看出一点儿问题。

王野继续说道：“舅舅可能觉得，从军从政的人，有点私心的多了，只要大原则坚定不移就可以。这就涉及到我性格中的另一方面了，做什么事情要么不做，要做就用心做。”

“就说我学医吧，最开始我是为了给赵爷爷看病，这么说虽然有些大言不惭，但是这也是我当时的目的，现在我师父已经能治疗赵爷爷了，但是我并没有放弃学医，虽然我以后当医生的概率不大，但是我仍要学下去。”

秦伟插话道：“这种品质很好，但是你说的无私奉献，也不是不能改变的啊，你还小，过些年你可能就能明白这种品质的高尚。”

王野：“舅舅，我不是不明白这种品质的高尚，我也很崇拜无私奉献的人们，不论是像您这样的军人，还是那些在岗位上发光发热的工人，我都很敬佩。但是敬佩不代表我就必须成为这样的人。”

王野顿了顿说道：“我从小就生活在乡下，这您也知道，我在认识陈大爷一家之前，见过最大的官儿就是我们院儿的李叔，他是我们那片儿的派出所所长。”

“我不像大哥一样，从小就听着你们的英雄事迹长大的，我听的都是家常里短，他们从小就立志成为像父辈儿一样的英雄，我从小立志是吃饱穿暖，这是根本上的区别。”

王野这时说的从小立志，是两世的自己都有这样的志向。前世孤儿出身的他，小时候能有什么大的志向。这要说长大了当医生，警察，科学家什么的，那也只是一句儿童的戏言。填饱肚子，找到亲人才是他当时最大的愿望。

秦伟沮丧的点了根儿烟，狠狠的抽了一口：“是我没有早点找到你们。”

王野劝解道：“舅舅，这和您没什么关系，真要是我娘和您没有失散，那有没有我还两说呢，既然过去的事儿都已经发生了，就不要过分纠结，现在我们不是都挺好的嘛！我娘和您相认，您不光找到了妹妹，还附赠了三个大外甥，外甥女。”

秦伟听着王野的话，笑骂道：“说的什么混账话，好像买东西给的赠品一样。”

王野挠了挠头：“话糙理不糙嘛！”

秦伟一直抽完手里的烟，才说道：“既然你下定决心了，我也尊重你的想法。”

After Wang Ye sat down, he said directly: "Uncle, I have thought a lot and have some thoughts during these days of business trip."

Qin Wei: "It would be great if you have an idea. Let's talk about it."

Wang Ye cleared his throat and said: "My original intention will not change. I will definitely not join the military or politics in the future."

Qin Wei frowned and asked, "Then what do you want to do?"

Wang Ye saw Qin Wei's unhappiness and said calmly: "Uncle, whether I am in the army or in politics, I believe that with your help, I will not be unknown even if I don't rise to great heights. But there is a fatal problem here, which is my character."

Qin Wei asked curiously: "I think your character is very suitable for this. Can you tell me what is the fatal problem with your character?"

Wang Ye said: "Whether you are in the military or politics, there is one must-have, and that is selfless dedication. I would not say that I am a selfish person, but I am not that great. If a public-private conflict really arises at work, I really don't know how to deal with it."

Qin Wei didn't speak, he just stared at Wang Ye closely, trying to detect whether he was perfunctory in his expression, but when Wang Ye evaluated him, he didn't see any problem.

Wang Ye continued: "My uncle may think that people who join the military and politics are a little more selfish. As long as the general principles are firm and unswerving, that's fine. This involves another aspect of my character. Whatever I do, I either don't do it, and when I do it, I do it with my heart."

"Let's just say that I studied medicine. At first, I wanted to treat Grandpa Zhao. Although it is a bit boastful to say this, it was also my purpose at the time. Now my master can treat Grandpa Zhao, but I have not given up studying medicine. Although the probability of me becoming a doctor in the future is low, I still want to continue studying."

Qin Wei interjected: "This quality is very good, but the selfless dedication you mentioned is not unchangeable. You are still young. In a few years you may be able to understand the nobleness of this quality."

Wang Ye: "Uncle, it's not that I don't understand the nobleness of this kind of quality. I also admire people who make selfless sacrifices. Whether they are soldiers like you or workers who shine at their posts, I admire them all. But admiration does not mean that I have to be such a person."

Wang Ye paused and said, "I have lived in the countryside since I was a child. As you know, before I met Uncle Chen's family, the biggest official I met was Uncle Li from our courtyard. He is the director of the police station in our area."

"Unlike my elder brother, I grew up listening to your heroic deeds. What I heard was all about family stories. They aspired to become heroes like their fathers since they were young. I aspired to be fed and clothed since I was a child. This is the fundamental difference."

What Wang Ye said at this time was that he had had such ambitions since he was young.As an orphan in his previous life, what big ambition could he have as a child?If you say you grow up to be a doctor, a policeman, a scientist, etc., that is just a children's joke.Filling his stomach and finding his relatives were his biggest wishes at the time.

Qin Wei lit a cigarette in frustration and took a long drag: "It's because I didn't find you earlier."

Wang Ye persuaded: "Uncle, this has nothing to do with you. If my mother and you are not separated, then I have two questions. Since the past has happened, don't get too entangled. We are all fine now! My mother recognizes you. Not only did you find your sister, but you also got three eldest nephews and nieces."

Qin Wei listened to Wang Ye's words and scolded with a smile: "What bastard words are you talking about? It's like a gift for buying something."

Wang Ye scratched his head: "It's rough words but not rough words!"

Qin Wei finished smoking the cigarette in his hand before saying, "Since you have made up your mind, I respect your idea."
